create_linear_expression: create a LinearExpression object with linear coefficients and offset for representing linear functions in relaxations
build_crown_rvt_relaxer: build an OpwiseLinearBoundsRelaxer using the CROWN-RVT mapper for midpoint and specialized ReLU, exp, and posbilinear relaxations
build_fastlin_rvt_relaxer: build an OpwiseLinearBoundsRelaxer using the FastLin-RVT mapper with specialized ReLU parallel bounds, exp tangent, and posbilinear relaxations
create_parameterized_relaxer: create an OpwiseParameterizedLinearBoundsRelaxer with parameterized relaxations for each primitive using piecewise linear, convex, or smooth convex strategies
concretize_linear_expression: concretize a LinearExpression against input bounds to compute the lower bound value of linear functions under interval constraints
